verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26182346 from Guangzhou PackRight to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318738 (dated 2026-09-16). It confirms two lines: 350,000 Game Card Cases (PR-CC-0312) at 1.44 CNY, confirmed for 2026-11-21, and 64,000 Cover Sleeves Grand Heist 6 (PR-SL-0604) at 0.4143 CNY, confirmed for 2026-11-16, artwork rev. B. Terms are FOB Yantian and NET30. The document has no handwritten changes or stamps.
red_flags: Line items are listed in the order 00020 then 00010, not in numerical order.
The document has no issue date of its own; only the customer order date (2026-09-16) is given.
The order quantities on the original PO are not shown, so they cannot be compared with the confirmed quantities.
observations: Typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
Header contains Chinese text (订单确认书) alongside English.
Unit of measure is not stated for the quantities.
